description.value: Noah's Cafe is a Japanese fusion bistro and cocktail bar on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, a short ride from the Stanley Park seawall. The kitchen offers creative tapas-style sharing plates — from aburi tuna tataki to wagyu beef tartare — alongside an omakase course experience. The bar program leans on Japanese spirits and techniques, making this an atmospheric evening stop for cyclists exploring the neighbourhood.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website is fully accessible and confirms Noah's Cafe is an active Japanese Fusion Bistro & Cocktail Bar at 1096 Denman Street, Vancouver BC V6G 2M8, with phone 604-559-1096 matching OSM. The dinner menu notes one item as 'Not available for take out,' implying takeout is generally offered for other items. No website or OSM content mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: Hours discrepancy: OSM lists closing at 24:00 daily and weekend lunch hours (Sa,Su 11:30-14:30), but website shows Mon-Sat 5PM-1AM and Sunday 5PM-12AM with no lunch service mentioned. Website hours should be considered more current.

Name mismatch: The website explicitly states 'Not Really A Cafe...' — the business is a full-service Japanese fusion bistro and cocktail bar, not a cafe, though the OSM name 'Noah's Cafe' is the operator's own branding.
